name: Midjourney
description: Midjourney is described on its own documentation as "your portal to transforming text into amazing images and videos" — an AI image/video generation tool.
best_for: Entering text prompts to generate a set of images, then varying, upscaling, remixing, or animating them into short videos, per the official documentation's description of core use.
features: Variations (Vary) for iterating on an image
Image-to-video (turns a still image into a short video)
Style Explorer for discovering style reference codes

alternatives.best_for: Marketing teams needing brand-governed visual and text content together.
